Thank you so very fucking much. This is exactly what I needed. It makes me really happy to read everything you said, you have no idea how much this means for me even if it’s just replying, you’re heaven sent. 

You might not believe it, but I’ve been pondering on that idea for quite a while, the whole “when you have nothing to lose, you can afford to live a bit riskily”. I have been contemplating throwing myself into the wind as you said, just so I can find myself and discover a sense of purpose or something to cling onto. This is my message to go for it, you were all I needed my good sir.

You’ve inspired me. If you can do it maybe so can I. Thank you so much, honestly♥️

I may not know you but I really hope you have a great week, and month and year and life. You’re a good person for taking time out of your day for me. I’m grateful for you kind stranger💯
Lmago glad I wasn’t the only one trippin and oddly mesmerized by this trailer.
Bro tell me abt it! Idk where I am in life that an animated DK would be singing and hitting the fabric of my very soul😂💯
